# VRV Global

VRV Global Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based commodity trading and integrated supply chain company.

## Business Summary
VRV Global operates across agro commodities, natural rubber, block rubber / TSR, industrial metals, mining ventures, and circular economy materials. The company focuses on responsible sourcing, traceability, sustainability, and long-term commodity supply chain partnerships.
